segments.text: men found out they had high blood pressure. One took beetroot every morning. The other took aged
garlic. Here's what happened to both of them. Day one, the first man goes to the doctor. His blood
pressure is 151 over 94. He goes home and orders beetroot powder because it's trending on social
media. Week one, it starts working. His number comes down and he's got a little more energy than
he used to have. Week two, the results start to fade. The number is creeping back up and he tells
himself he's just imagining it. Week four, he doubles the scoop. Nothing happens. He tells
himself he needs to give it more time. Month two, he puts the cuff on again and he's right back where
he started. 151 over 94. He feels scammed as fuck. Here's why that happened. Beetroot loosens the
artery so blood flows easier. That's it. The cholesterol and calcium clogging the artery are
still sitting there. So once the beetroot wears off, the artery stiffens again and the blood pressure
goes right back to where it was before. Now rewind two months and see what happens when the second guy
takes aged garlic instead. Day one, he goes to the doctor. His blood pressure is also 151 over 94.
The only difference is he starts taking aged garlic instead of beetroot powder. And here's what happens.
Week one, he starts peeing more. And that's a sign the S-allyl cysteine from aged garlic is building up
in his system. Week two, he gets to the top of the stairs without getting out of breath. He gets up off the
couch without the dizziness. And he wakes up feeling clear in his head instead of foggy. Week four,
he's still got energy left after work for his kids, for his wife. He watches an entire movie with her
without falling asleep halfway through. That tightness in his chest is gone because the
cholesterol is actually coming off the artery wall now. Month two, he measures his blood pressure
again. 129 over 82. And it stays there. This happens because of one compound, S-allyl cysteine.
It comes from aged garlic. When it reaches the artery wall, it melts the cholesterol. It's been
hardening there for years and scrapes the calcium away underneath it. The arteries open back up,
blood moves freely again, and the blood pressure comes down on its own because what was causing it
is finally being addressed. But not all aged garlic works. Most aged garlic is only aged a few weeks,
but it takes 20 months for the S-allyl cysteine to form in garlic. Resilia is one of the only brands
that ages garlic the full 20 months. And the color of the soft gel is your proof. The dark
amber color means it's aged the full 20 months in complete darkness. Third-party tested. Made in
the USA. Two soft gels every morning. They make it in small batches because the fermentation can't be
rushed. If you can still see the link below, that means it's still in stock.
